thread:
Ana: quick async standup — post 1 line each: what you shipped, any blockers, plan for today. focus: iam perms cleanup, kms rotations, audit queue (COM-*), and image rebuilds.

Mike: shipped: permission review for svc-data-export (audit-ref: AU-778). tightened S3 access to prefix-level. PR at #5240. blocker: need rotation window confirmed before I remove old keys.

Sofia: shipped: prototype patch for tokenizer CVE mitigation, pushed branch fix/tokenizer-sanitize. blocker: the dedicated runtime images still include old vendor wheel; need eng-runtime to rebuild images to pick up wheel v2.

Nate: shipped: ran key-rotation dry-run on dev for rk-789, smoke passed for request signing. command used:
```
redwood-kms rotate --key-id rk-789 --env dev --dry-run
```
blocker: staging auth failed once when the cache wasn't flushed (401) — will investigate TTL.

Ana: @Nate please paste the exact error line when you have it. @Sofia re: images — can you list which PRs are blocked so I can prioritize the rebuild?

Sofia: PRs blocked: #5205 (tokenizer patch) and #5212 (deps bump for llm-utils). both are low-risk.

Mike: added justification in #5240 for removing old keys and included rollback steps. also opened RJ-2351 to track infra impacts.

Nate: error snippet: "auth: signature verification failed: signing key rk-789 not found" — looks like agents were still using cached public keys. flushed cache with: `kubectl exec -n infra cache-pod -- redis-cli FLUSHALL` then retried, success.

sec-bot: reminder: COM-472 (data-retention audit) assigned to Mike & Ana, due 2026-06-05.

Ana: scheduling: eng-runtime image rebuild tonight 02:00-03:30 UTC. will post notice to #incidents and announce in #general. @eng-runtime please ack.

Mike: ack. I'll hold the svc-data-export key removal until after the 03:00 UTC window.

Nate: promoted rotation to staging after cache flush; staging smoke passed. plan to queue prod rotation at 11:45 PT pending infra go-ahead.

Sofia: once images are rebuilt I can merge both PRs and kick off the dedicated-image CI. can we make the rebuild non-disruptive?

Ana: aim is non-disruptive — we'll use blue/green for the runtime images. runbook note: add rollback command `redwood-kms rotate --rollback --key-id <id>` to runbooks/iam after this is done.

sec-ops-bot: incident draft created: "eng-runtime image rebuild for KMS & tokenizer patches" (link posted).

Ana: blockers recap: Mike hold removal until post-window, eng-runtime to ack and rebuild tonight, Nate to confirm prod rotation after infra checks. I'll close thread after prod rotation + merges. :thumbsup:
